data.name: Ashes of Midgard
data.detailed_description:
Ashes of Midgard is a Viking-themed survival game set in a world overrun by the undead. Gather resources, build your base, and fight to survive in the frozen ruins of Midgard.

Start with nothing and carve your place in a harsh, post-Ragnarok world. Hunt animals for food, chop trees for wood, and mine stone and iron to expand your settlement. Every tool, weapon, and piece of armor must be crafted at your forge — and every night brings new dangers.

Defend your camp from waves of Draugr and corrupted creatures that roam the wild. Build walls, towers, and traps to protect your people. Upgrade your equipment to survive longer, explore farther, and take down stronger enemies.

The world of Midgard is vast and unforgiving. Explore snow-covered forests, ancient ruins, and cursed battlefields to uncover valuable resources and lost relics. Weather conditions, hunger, and stamina all play a role in your survival.

Core Features:

- Gather & Craft: Collect wood, stone, and iron to craft tools, weapons, and armor.

- Build & Defend: Construct your Viking settlement and fortify it against undead attacks.

- Survive the Elements: Manage hunger, stamina, and exposure in a brutal frozen world.

- Combat the Undead: Face Draugr, beasts, and other mythic creatures inspired by Norse legend.

- Forge & Upgrade: Use the forge to craft powerful items and improve your gear.

- Explore & Discover: Roam a dangerous open world filled with hidden secrets, resources, and enemy camps.

- Thrive Together (Optional Co-op): Build, fight, and survive alongside other Vikings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.4 Ghz Dual Core CPU
  • Graphics: 2 GB Dedicated Memory
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
